rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_unconstrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.3516, n_angles=128, n_det=1024, det_spacing=0.35754, sod=500.0, sdd=1000.0, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.5, train_n=400, val_n=200, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.05, fd_recon_eta=0.1, fd_recon_dc=0, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, rationale=iter-13: DC-off breast-prior. ONE KNOB init_t 0.1->0.05. PRIOR (low-eta): init_t0.2->PSNR29.58, init_t0.1->PSNR31.88 (big jump). MECHANISM CONFIRMED: as init_t->0 the DC-off sampler converges to the FBP init (minimal generative perturbation) + light prior denoise => PSNR rises toward the FBP baseline (36.32). HYPOTHESIS: init_t=0.05 pushes PSNR further toward baseline (recon ~= lightly-denoised FBP). This is the KEY finding: the breast prior alone (no DC) can only APPROACH the FBP asymptotically by trusting it - it cannot EXCEED it, because without the CG data-consistency projection there is no mechanism to inject the missing sparse-view null-space information. hr stays 0 (RMSE never beats the FBP's 5.2e-3).
